Package org.uma.evolver.meta.llm

Class OpenAiCompatibleClient

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.meta.llm.OpenAiCompatibleClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
LlmClient
public final class OpenAiCompatibleClient extends Object implements LlmClient
A model behind the OpenAI chat completions API (POST <baseUrl>/chat/completions), the one that OpenAI, vLLM, LM Studio, the llama.cpp server, OpenRouter and Ollama itself ( http://localhost:11434/v1) offer. The JSON schema of the answer goes in response_format (json_schema, strict). The key, when the server needs one, is sent as a bearer token; options are added to the request as they are.

      public OpenAiCompatibleClient(String baseUrl, String model, String apiKey, double temperature, Duration timeout, Map<String,Object> options)
      Parameters:
      baseUrl - the address of the API, with its version, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1
      model - the name of the model
      apiKey - the key of the API, or null if the server needs none
      temperature - the sampling temperature
      timeout - the time to wait for an answer
      options - more fields of the request, added as they are (may be empty)
